        textResizer = $(function () {
            // Set Cookie
            var docCookies = {
                getItem: function (sKey) {
                    if (!sKey) { return null; }
                    return decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.replace(new RegExp("(?:(?:^|.*;)\\s*" + encodeURIComponent(sKey).replace(/[\-\.\+\*]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*\\=\\s*([^;]*).*$)|^.*$"), "$1")) || null;
                },
                setItem: function (sKey, sValue, vEnd, sPath, sDomain, bSecure) {
                    if (!sKey || /^(?:expires|max\-age|path|domain|secure)$/i.test(sKey)) { return false; }
                    var sExpires = "";
                    if (vEnd) {
                        switch (vEnd.constructor) {
                            case Number:
                                sExpires = vEnd === Infinity ? "; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 9999 23:59:59 GMT" : "; max-age=" + vEnd;
                                break;
                            case String:
                                sExpires = "; expires=" + vEnd;
                                break;
                            case Date:
                                sExpires = "; expires=" + vEnd.toUTCString();
                                break;
                        }
                    }
                    sPath = "/";
                    document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(sKey) + "=" + encodeURIComponent(sValue) + sExpires + (sDomain ? "; domain=" + sDomain : "") + (sPath ? "; path=" + sPath : "") + (bSecure ? "; secure" : "");
                    return true;
                },
                removeItem: function (sKey, sPath, sDomain) {
                    if (!this.hasItem(sKey)) { return false; }
                    document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(sKey) + "=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT" + (sDomain ? "; domain=" + sDomain : "") + (sPath ? "; path=" + sPath : "");
                    return true;
                },
                hasItem: function (sKey) {
                    if (!sKey) { return false; }
                    return (new RegExp("(?:^|;\\s*)" + encodeURIComponent(sKey).replace(/[\-\.\+\*]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*\\=")).test(document.cookie);
                },
            };
            function changeAllElemSize(element, size) {
                var ck = parseInt(docCookies.getItem("FontSize"));
                if (isNaN(ck) || ck == -500) {
                    ck = 0;
                    if (size == undefined) {
                        return;
                    }
                }
                if (size === 'decrease') {
                    ck = ck - 1;
                }
                else if (size === 'increase') {
                    ck = ck + 1;
                }
                else if (size === 'default') {
                    ck = undefined;
                    docCookies.setItem("FontSize", -500, Infinity);
                    location.reload();
                }
                changeSize(element, ck);
                docCookies.setItem("FontSize", ck, Infinity);
            }
            function changeSize(element, ck) {
                var current = parseInt($(element).attr("data-font-size"));
                var newSize;
                if (isNaN(current)) {
                    //current = parseInt($(element).css('font-size'));
                    current = parseInt($("body").css('font-size'));
                    $(element).attr('data-font-size', current + 'px');
                }
                newSize = current + ck;
                $(element).css('font-size', newSize + 'px');
            }
            $('#decreaseFont').click(function (e) {
                changeAllElemSize(text, 'decrease');
                e.preventDefault();
            });
            $('#increaseFont').click(function (e) {
                changeAllElemSize(text, 'increase');
                e.preventDefault();
            });
            $('#default').click(function (e) {
                changeAllElemSize(text, 'default');
                e.preventDefault();
            });
            var text = $("*");
            changeAllElemSize(text);
        });
    </script>

        function CareerSearchJobs_Customisation() {

            HideHeaderMenuTabsButSearchJob();

            var inputButtons = $("input[type=button].btn.btn-primary");

        function Wpc_GetCustomJobDescription(jobContentLeftEach) {
            var jobDescItems = [];
            var expRow = jobContentLeftEach.find("strong:contains('Experience')").parent();

            var jobLocationRow = jobContentLeftEach.find("i.fa.fa-map-marker").parent();
            var primarySkillRow = jobContentLeftEach.find("strong:contains('Primary Skills')").parent();


            var experience = expRow.clone()    //clone the element
                .children() //select all the children
                .remove()   //remove all the children
                .end()  //again go back to selected element
                .text().trim();

                var filterBodyId = "FilterBody_" + index1;
                var txtFilterSearchId = "WpcTxtFilterSearch_" + index1;
                var filterSecTitle = item1.SectionTitle;

                tempFilterSectionHtml = tempFilterSectionHtml.replaceAll("##FilterSectionTitleHtml##", tempFilterSectionTitleHtml);
                tempFilterSectionHtml = tempFilterSectionHtml.replaceAll("##WpcTxtFilterSearch##", txtFilterSearchId);


                var filterLinkHtmlData = "";

                    if (!filterTitle.includes(",")) {

                        tempFilterLinkHtml = tempFilterLinkHtml.replaceAll("##FilterHref##", filterUrl);

                        filterLinkHtmlData += tempFilterLinkHtml;
                    }

                tempFilterSectionHtml = tempFilterSectionHtml.replaceAll("##FilterBodyId##", filterBodyId);
                tempFilterSectionHtml = tempFilterSectionHtml.replace("##FilterLinkHtml##", filterLinkHtmlData.toString())

                _result += tempFilterSectionHtml;
            });

            return _result.toString();

        function Wpc_GetFooterData() {
            var filterDataSource = [];

            //Hide footer

        function Wpc_BindFilterSearchEvent() {
            $("[id^=WpcTxtFilterSearch_]").keyup(function () {

            chkFilter = $(chkFilter);

            var hrefVal = chkFilter.attr("wpc-data-href");
            var btnSearchJobs = $("#btnSearch_");

            if (typeof hrefVal != "undefined") {
                var hrefParts = hrefVal.split("?");

                if (hrefParts.length > 1) {
                    var jobQs = hrefParts[1];
                    var jobQsParts = jobQs.split("-");
                    if (jobQsParts.length > 1) {
                        var filterCategory = jobQsParts[0].trim();
                        var filterVal = jobQsParts[1].trim();

                        if (isFilterChecked) {
                            UpdateFilterDataSource(isFilterChecked, filterCategory, filterVal);
                        }
                        else {
                            var filterCount = GetCountOfFilterText(chkFilter, filterVal);
                            if (filterCount == 0) {
                                UpdateFilterDataSource(isFilterChecked, filterCategory, filterVal);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (btnSearchJobs.length > 0) {
                btnSearchJobs[0].click();
            }

            //angular.element(document.getElementById('SearchJobDiv')).scope().getHotLinksAndJobs();

                var hrefParts = hrefVal.split("?");

                if (hrefParts.length > 1) {
                    var jobQs = hrefParts[1];
                    var jobQsParts = jobQs.split("-");
                    if (jobQsParts.length > 1) {
                        var filterCategory = jobQsParts[0].trim();
                        result = jobQsParts[1].trim();
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        function GetCountOfFilterText(chkFilter, filterVal) {
            var count = 0;
            var chkFilter_Parent = chkFilter.parent().parent("div[data-wpc-tag='filterBody']");
            var chkbx;
            $(chkFilter_Parent.children()).each(function (index, item) {
                item = $(item);
                chkbx = item.find("input[type='checkbox']");
                if (chkbx.prop("checked")) {
                    var chkFilterVal = GetFilterNameFromHref(chkbx.attr("wpc-data-href"));
                    if (typeof chkFilterVal != "undefined") {
                        if (chkFilterVal == filterVal) {
                            count++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            })
            return count;
        }

        function UpdateFilterDataSource(isFilterAdding, categoryName, filter) {
            //filterDataSource;
            if (isFilterAdding) {
                //Add filter data
                Wpc_AddFilterCategory(categoryName, filter);
            }
            else {
                //Remove filter data
                Wpc_RemoveFilterCategory(categoryName, filter);
            }
        }

        function Wpc_GetFilterCategoryByName(categoryName) {
            var result;
            $(filterDataSource).each(function (index, item) {
                if (item.CategoryName == categoryName) {
                    result = item;
                    return false;
                }

            });
            return result;
        }

        function Wpc_AddFilterCategory(categoryName, filter) {
            var category = Wpc_GetFilterCategoryByName(categoryName);
            if (typeof category != "undefined") {
                var filters = category.Filters;
                //add if not existing
                if (!filters.includes(filter)) {
                    category.Filters.push(filter);
                }
            }
            else {
                //Add new
                var filterData = {};
                filterData.CategoryName = categoryName;
                filterData.Filters = [filter];

                filterDataSource.push(filterData)
            }
        }

        function Wpc_RemoveFilterCategory(categoryName, filter) {
            var category = Wpc_GetFilterCategoryByName(categoryName);
            if (typeof category != "undefined") {
                var filters = category.Filters;
                //remove if existing
                if (filters.includes(filter)) {
                    Wpc_RemoveArrayItem(category.Filters, filter);
                }
            }
        }

        function Wpc_RemoveArrayItem(arr, value) {
            var i = 0;
            while (i < arr.length) {
                if (arr[i] === value) {
                    arr.splice(i, 1);
                } else {
                    ++i;
                }
            }
            return arr;
        }
